recommendedTextbook.title: Christian Religious Studies for Junior Secondary Schools Book 1
recommendedTextbook.author: T. N. O. Quarcoopome
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: The Sovereignty of God: The Creation Account in Genesis
subtopics: The biblical creation story (Genesis 1 and 2): Order of creation
God's sovereignty over living and non-living creatures
Human stewardship over nature: Environmental conservation and animal welfare
objectives: Recount the day-by-day order of creation in Genesis 1
Explain the theological concept of humans being created in the 'image and likeness of God'
Identify 3 ways students can practice godly stewardship over natural resources in Nigeria

topics.topic: God Cares for His People: Provision in the Wilderness
subtopics: The Exodus from Egypt and crossing of the Red Sea (Exodus 14)
God's provision of manna, quails, and water from the rock (Exodus 16 and 17)
Lessons of divine faithfulness, patience, and gratitude during national economic hardship
objectives: Narrate how God miraculously delivered the Israelites at the Red Sea
Describe God's daily provision of manna and water in the wilderness of Sin
Draw moral parallels showing that God provides for family needs in tough economic times

topics.topic: Parental Responsibility: The Families of Eli and Samuel Compared
subtopics: Eli as high priest and the irresponsible conduct of Hophni and Phinehas (1 Samuel 2)
God's judgment on the house of Eli for lack of parental discipline
The child Samuel dedicated to God by Hannah and his obedient listening (1 Samuel 3)
objectives: Identify the specific sins committed by Eli's sons in the temple of Shiloh
Explain consequences of poor parental upbringing and lack of disciplinary restraint
Contrast Eli's failure with Hannah's prayerful consecration of Samuel

topics.topic: Obedience to God: The Call and Faith of Abraham
subtopics: The call of Abram from Ur of the Chaldees to an unknown land (Genesis 12)
God's unconditional covenant promises to Abraham (great nation, blessings, land of Canaan)
Abraham's supreme obedience in the sacrifice of Isaac on Mount Moriah (Genesis 22)
objectives: List the 7 divine promises made to Abraham upon his departure from Haran
Demonstrate how Abraham exhibited extraordinary faith during the trial on Mount Moriah
State 3 moral benefits of obedience to parents, teachers, and statutory laws
